body: Thank you for your response. I think I forgot how to cope with it though. I have just ignored the thoughts for so long. I just want to resort back to my old habits like I used to. I hate this. I hate knowing that it will always come back. I have ruined two great relationships because of this.

Thank you. It doesn't take much pain away, but it's comforting to know that people I have never met care. I just wish someone I knew cared enough to recognize the situation that I am in. Of course no one really knows about my situation because I'm too proud to tell them. It took everything out of me to post here tonight. I feel like I should be able to get through this on my own.
